title: Questions 191-195 refer to the following e-mails and brochure.
passage_1:
To:Marisol Quintero <m.quintero@quinterostudio.com>
From:Dermot Ashworth <ashworth@tidewell.com>
Date:2 January
Subject:Collaboration

Dear Ms. Quintero,

I represent Tidewell Watersports, a company that makes high-end paddleboards. Our chief executive saw the illustrations you produced for Corvid Kites and was extremely impressed. I would like to discuss the possibility of your creating artwork for our Driftline range of boards. The range is provisionally scheduled for release on 4 May, but we can move this back to 18 June if you are unable to begin immediately because of other commitments.

Please let me know whether you would be interested in working with us. If so, I would be glad to visit your studio next week to discuss the project in detail.

Sincerely,
Dermot Ashworth
Production Manager
Tidewell Watersports

Tidewell’s Driftline Paddleboard Range

Driftline boards have a paulownia wood core wrapped in a light carbon shell. This makes them both rigid and hard-wearing, giving excellent performance in all conditions. With striking artwork by the renowned illustrator Marisol Quintero, these boards are certain to attract both beginners and competitive racers alike. The Driftline range will be available for purchase on 18 June and includes the following models:

  • Harbour: An all-round board suited to most stretches of water
  • Sprint: Built for speed on flat water
  • Surge: Ideal for catching waves in the surf
  • Expedition: A rugged board for long open-water crossings

Further information about these boards is available at www.tidewell.com/range.

To:Gareth Iwu <g.iwu@branchmail.com>
From:Nuala Brennan <n.brennan@tidewell.com>
Date:12 November
Subject:Re: Order # 118402

Dear Mr. Iwu,

Please accept our apology for sending you a Harbour board by mistake. Unfortunately, the model you originally chose is now sold out and will not be restocked until February. To make up for our mistake, we are sending you a £75 gift card. Regarding the Harbour board you received, please let us know whether you would like to keep it. I appreciate that you ordered the board built specifically for long open-water crossings, but the Harbour handles that kind of water well too. It is also covered by the same two-year warranty. If this is not acceptable, a full refund is available. Please tell me which option you would prefer.

Sincerely,
Nuala Brennan
Customer Service Manager
Tidewell Watersports
